observations.statement: POST /api/checkout answers 201 with an order, and the UI shows an empty cart.
The next POST /api/cart/items answers with two lines: the purchased keyboard and the mouse.

hypotheses.statement: Shop.checkout() creates the order without emptying the session cart on the server.
hypotheses.rationale: The server returns the purchased line after checkout, so the server cart was never cleared.

intervention.description: Empty the session cart in Shop.checkout() after recording the order.

hypotheses.statement: The client's checkout() never calls DELETE /api/cart, which exists to clear the server cart.
hypotheses.rationale: The UI draws an empty cart locally after checkout without telling the server.

intervention.replace:
const order = await api("/api/checkout", { method: "POST" });
  await api("/api/cart", { method: "DELETE" });
intervention.description: Call DELETE /api/cart right after a successful checkout.

hypotheses.statement: continueShopping() restores the previous cart view on the client.
hypotheses.rationale: The keyboard reappears right after pressing Continue shopping.

intervention.description: Clear the rendered cart list when continuing to shop.
